title: add transactional downgrade-guard + backup/restore + schema migrations to private-installer
author: Aisha Kapoor
description:
This PR adds a transactional downgrade guard and end-to-end backup/restore integration for the private-installer path, and wires transactional schema migrations into the upgrade/rollback tooling. Motivation: we observed a cluster outage during a cross-version upgrade where partial schema migrations plus a failed upgrade left the DB in an inconsistent state. The goal is to make upgrades and downgrades safe for on-prem/VPC customers by: 1) adding a transactional migration runner that runs migrations inside a single DB transaction (where supported) and rolls back on failure; 2) adding explicit downgrade-guard checks that prevent automatic downgrades when irreversible migrations or version-pin mismatches are detected; 3) integrating the backup/restore flow into the installer and upgrade CLI so that operators can take a pre-upgrade snapshot and validate restore before proceeding; 4) updating Helm charts and Terraform modules to expose version pinning and safety flags. This PR is intentionally conservative: new flags default to safe values (require_confirm=true, auto_downgrade=false) and the transactional path is opt-in for deployments that set DB_SUPPORTS_TRANSACTIONS=true. Checklist:
- [x] transactional migration runner implementation and unit tests
- [x] downgrade detection logic + unit tests
- [x] backup/restore CLI hooks and integration tests (local k8s tarball flow)
- [x] Helm values and Terraform inputs documented
- [x] e2e upgrade/rollback scenario validated in perf-canary cluster
- [x] release notes and upgrade guidance added to docs site
Related Linear: ENG-4782 (upgrade safety), SRE-391 (backup/restore validation). Related support ticket: SUP-234 (customer reported failed downgrade). Links: docs/private-installer/upgrade.md, helm/redwood/templates/pre-upgrade-hook.yaml

review_comments: Diego Martinez (reviewer): Nice end-to-end flow. Two asks: a) make the transactional path explicit in the Helm chart docs so on-prem customers understand DB requirements, b) add a healthcheck after restore in the pre-upgrade job.

Aisha Kapoor (author): Added explicit docs and healthcheck probe in pre-upgrade job, see latest commit. The transactional path remains opt-in because some embedded DBs don't support DDL in transactions.
Priya Nair (reviewer): Left a couple of nits around logging (include migration id on failure) and a suggestion to throttle backup size for S3 uploads. Not blocking.
Evan Zhang (approver): Verified e2e in perf-canary and the rollback scenario. Approving pending CI green. Observed intermittent test failure on migration lock; author fixed in f55b8aa.

release_notes: Add transactional migration runner and downgrade guard for private-installer; backup/restore pre-upgrade validation; Helm/Terraform flags for version pinning and safety controls. Operators should validate DB transactional support before enabling transactional migrations.
